job.question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS) investment consulting services RFP?
job.acceptance: Accept Central Time/CT; explicit equivalent timezone conversion acceptable.

reviews.reason: The document is a 2011 District of Columbia Retirement Board real assets consulting RFP, not the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System investment consulting services RFP. Its proposal deadline does not support the OPERS deadline.
quotes: District of Columbia Retirement Board 900 7th Street, N.W. Suite 200 Washington, D.C. 20001 Request for Proposal Real Assets Investment Consulting Services
Proposal Due Date: February 25, 2011 at 5:00 p.m. EST
